g1.flow: Same words in both: fa-huwa fī ʿīshatin rāḍiyah. Al-Qāriʿah sets it between the scales: heavy scales before it, light scales after it. Al-Ḥāqqah sets it after a speaker's own words, 'I was certain I would be meeting my account', and follows it with 'In an elevated garden'. Hook: Al-Qāriʿah's pleasant life sits on the scales; Al-Ḥāqqah's leads into the garden.

cues.69:21: After 'I was certain I would be meeting my account'; next, an elevated garden.
cues.101:7: After 'scales are heavy'; next, the turn to one whose scales are light.
